text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So... many... people! And they all
have a
twinkle in their eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower and I are watching
the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One week ago, during training...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... wheeze... Rice... wait up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(This is Sakura Bakushin O. She's in Rice
Shower's
year, and she excels in sprints.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I have some class

representative responsibilities I was
supposed to
take care of, but I decided
to run with you
instead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your stamina is off the charts! So I'm
going to
make a suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow long-distance runner, I want
you to
come watch the spring Tenno Sho
with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You want to watch the Tenno Sho...
together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yep, together! Working with my fellow
classmates
to help them discover their
hidden talents is one
of my duties as
class representative, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I wouldn't call it a "hidden" talent,
Sakura
Bakushin O is correct. Rice
Shower has what it
takes to be a
long-distance stayer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the spring Tenno Sho may someday
be a goal
of hers.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I would have been so lonely going
on my
own! Also, we have a snack
budget of 300 yen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually... it kind of feels like we're
going on a
field trip. Hehe, I'm getting
excited!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner with 600
meters left
to the finish line, the leader
is... Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Gooo, McQueen! Make them eat your
dust!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This is a close one! I'm gonna go
get a
better view.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is widening her lead!
No matter
how hard the racers behind
her run...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They can't reach her! No one can come
close to
her!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In a display of incredible speed, Mejiro
McQueen
crosses the finish line in first!
What a sight!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congrats! Good job, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! It's thanks to your
support
that I managed to seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She was incredible. So skilled...
and so
radiant!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The farther McQueen ran, the more
everyone
smiled...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She's just like the blue rose from the
picture
book!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the blue rose that brings
happiness to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower excitedly retells the story of The Blue Rose of Good Fortune.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a garden full of roses, a single blue
rose bud
suddenly bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There had never been a blue rose
before, and the
people feared it. They
called it the "flower of
misfortune" and
kept their distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But one day, someone bought the rose.
"Why,
this blue rose is simply
magnificent!" they
exclaimed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then they—Big Brother—placed the blue
rose on
his windowsill, and it bloomed so
beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then they—Big Sister—placed the blue
rose on
her windowsill, and it bloomed
so beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That the people walking by would smile
from the
bottom of their hearts when
they saw it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, McQueen has always been
well-liked, so it's
not exactly the same.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I want to be like that. I want to be
someone
who brings happiness instead
of misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You don't have to try and cheer
me up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But, if it's possible... I would like to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We watch Mejiro McQueen for a while
longer and
then head home.
